note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The witnesses agree on the substantive text.

adjudicated.ours: Mater Dei, dum stéteris in conspéctu Dómini,
adjudicated.ruling: The typical edition prints the offertory of the September feast as Recordáre, Virgo Mater Dei, dum stéteris in conspéctu Dómini (p. 672). The digital source prints Virgo Mater, in conspéctu Dei.
